notes_sections.heading: Geographic exclusions — opened and confirmed
items: Site Reliability Engineer (6+ years), financial services client, Toronto, 9-month contract, no stated remote track (Job 155055): excellent skill overlap (Python, GitHub Actions, observability, RCA/MTTR, even an AI-assisted-engineering nice-to-have matching Marc's Énergir practice) but Toronto with no remote option — outside the reachable range. Closest near-miss this run.

Infrastructure Engineer (5+ years), bare-metal Cisco UCS/Ansible/Windows/RHEL, Toronto, hybrid 2 days (could rise to 4), 12 months (Job 154922): geography-excluded; also a real skill gap (no Cisco UCS/bare-metal hardware lifecycle experience).

Intermediate Network Automation Developer, Oil & Gas client, Calgary, hybrid 3 days onsite/2 remote, 1-year contract (Job 154846): geography-excluded; also requires TypeScript/React frontend development depth Marc doesn't have.
Application Release Engineer III (2–5 years), financial services client, Toronto, hybrid 2 days onsite, 6 months (Job 154805): geography-excluded; also a junior-scoped role for Marc's level.

Senior Cloud Platform Engineer (8–10 years), financial services client, Toronto, hybrid 4 days/week, 1 year (Job 154794): excellent Azure/Terraform/Ansible/IaC overlap, but Toronto and 4 days/week both independently exclude it.

Manager, Site Reliability Engineering, Etobicoke (Greater Toronto Area), hybrid 3x/week, permanent (Job 154487): geography-excluded; also a formal people-management role (3+ years leading teams required) that doesn't match Marc's individual-contributor positioning.

notes_sections.heading: Not opened this run — consistent Toronto/Calgary pattern
items: Technical Specialist (Azure & Databricks DevOps Engineer), Systems Engineer (infrastructure modernization, M365/Azure), and Senior Infrastructure Operations Lead (VMware/backup/DR) all appeared as Toronto or Calgary-tagged in the results list, consistent with every other on-site/hybrid posting opened this run — not opened individually given that consistent pattern, but not confirmed ineligible either; worth a spot-check if this source is rechecked soon.

Clear scope exclusions not opened: Senior Manager Technology Services (Ottawa, people-management + non-IC scope, matches a previously logged exclusion), Senior Operational Engineer (telephony/Teams/Amazon Connect), 2× Senior Network Security Engineer/Specialist postings (security-analyst center of gravity), Senior Netcracker Application Specialist (telecom OSS/BSS), Int/Sr Network Infrastructure Engineer (automotive client, network-hardware specific), Specialty Developer III (mobile DevOps CI/CD — mobile app build tooling, not infra), Specialty Developer (mainframe DevOps Deploy/z/OS — mainframe app deployment, not infra), Genesys Platform Lead/SME (contact-center platform, not DevOps/SRE/Platform).

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: Ran 2 of the 8 default-rotation searches (DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer) and stopped there: both returned the same ~20-result core inventory in slightly different order/count (29 vs 31 total), confirming the skill's documented warning that q= is a soft ranking signal, not a real filter — running the remaining 6 keywords would very likely re-surface the same set rather than new postings. Every genuinely target-family posting found was Toronto or Calgary; this appears to be a real, current inventory skew for this source's Networks and Infrastructure category, not a search artifact.
Direct HTTP (including WebFetch) is blocked by S.i. Systems' WAF, confirmed again this run — used the browser for every search and detail page, per the skill's documented requirement.
No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, or write-side action occurred.
